主要内容: On March 27, 2019, Freshstart Venture Capital Corp., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note. The Loan Agreement, effective January 25, 2017, and the Note, effective March 1, 2017, were amended by the U.S. Small Business Administration. The amendments included technical changes. The full text of the amendments is referenced in Exhibits 4.1 and 10.1 of the Form 8-K filing. The amendments were executed to update the terms of the financial agreements between SBA, FVC, and MFD. The changes are part of the ongoing financial operations of the company and its subsidiaries, reflecting adjustments to the existing contractual obligations. The amendments do not alter the fundamental nature of the agreements but may affect the terms of future financial reporting and obligations. The amendments are relevant to the financial services industry and the operations of Medallion Financial Corp. and its subsidiaries.
